failure_summary.description: Searches or filters were left unassigned or unsaved, or cache retrieval was nested directly in a filter call.
A new constraint was omitted or not applied independently to all relevant cached results, including itinerary legs.
Generated code added unsupported model definitions, result merging, printing, or unrelated cache retrievals.
A state abbreviation was passed as an attraction city instead of using the state field.
A flight-time filter used HH:MM:SS values instead of the accepted 12-hour AM/PM format.
A hotel checkout date and stay length were invented without user-provided information.
The nearest-results grouping was set to the restaurant domain when the user wanted hotel options grouped.

patch.reasoning: Most observed errors already violate explicit skill rules, so adding duplicate instructions would not address a content gap. The proximity rule's description of groupBy as the anchor domain is ambiguous and can direct the tool to group the wrong results; clarify that it is the domain the user wants listed.

edits.target: Use `search_nearest` only when the user asks about proximity, with relevant domain results and `groupBy` set to the requested anchor domain.
edits.content: Use `search_nearest` only when the user asks about proximity, with the two relevant domain results and `groupBy` set to the target domain—the results the user wants listed or grouped, not the anchor (for example, hotels near restaurants uses `groupBy="hotel"`; restaurants near hotels uses `groupBy="restaurant"`).
